common.footerTagline: Made for the games you bring to the table.

setupNotice.title: Connect your app to start playing.
setupNotice.description: The collection and group screens need Clerk, PostgreSQL, and the API settings. Add the values described in the README, then reload this page.

home.bannerText: Signed in. Your game nights, groups, and collection await on your Dashboard.
home.heroSubtitle: Bring everyone's games together and draw one that fits your table.
home.step1Text: Find a game through BoardGameGeek once. Its details live in your collection from then on.
home.step2Text: Invite friends by email and share only the games you want the group to see.
home.step3Text: Enter your player count and get a random pick from games your group shares.
home.previewSubtitle: Each game appears once in a group, with the people who shared it right there. A game stays in the group even if one of several owners stops sharing.

groupVoting.title: Want to Play · Group Wishlist
groupVoting.description: Vote for any game (yours or a friend's!) to increase its chances in upcoming Game Nights. Points only degrade when a game wins!
groupVoting.badgeTooltip: Your votes are invested in games to increase their chances. Every Monday you reload +3 points (up to max 5 in hand). When a game is played, invested points are released.
